thread:
lia: Quick sync from PM-2910 follow-ups  we need owners for the incident-driven tests so they land in CI and in the monthly chaos drills. Proposing three tickets: prompt corpus, bounded load scenario, and routing/fallback harness.

omar: I'll take the bounded load scenario. Need a stage-only job that can run a 12m burst and optionally restart a subset of KV cache pods mid-run. Will open INF-4599 and sketch the scripts.

bea: I'll assemble the prompt corpus and validators. Plan: 130 prompts sampled from incident dumps, with categories: latency-only / semantic / core-regression. Will provide CSV + small sample artifact. Ticket INF-4600.

mira: Who will own the CI integration and dashboard? We want a nightly job and a Console tile showing p95, error-rate, and pass/fail for the core set.

lia: I can wire the CI job and dashboard. Will add `ci/evals/incident-guard` and a dashboard in Console/tests/incident-guards. Ticket INF-4601. ETA ~10 days.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4599 by omar - "stage load scenario + kv-restart (reproduce tail)"

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4600 by bea - "incident prompt corpus: 130 samples + validators"

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4601 by lia - "CI job + dashboard: incident guards"

omar: For the load scenario I'll include a sample wrk command and a small lua that exercises long seq lengths. Example in repro steps. We'll assert p95 < 400ms and error-rate < 1%. Prototype in 4 days, stage job in 8.

bea: For validators: latency-only prompts get prefix/length checks; semantic ones get regex or small semantic matchers. Core-regression subset (30 prompts) will be strict and run in CI. I'll tag sources for traceability. PR in ~3 days.

lia: CI job will accept per-prompt validators; latency-only prompts will skip token equality. Dashboard tile will show historical p95, mean, and a pass/fail sparkline for the core-regression group.

mira: Please link INF-4599/4600/4601 to PM-2910 and add a "repro steps" block and artifacts. Gate for review: each ticket must have a runnable script, sample data, and monitoring hooks.

omar: Linking now and adding runbook stub. Also will include an optional KV eviction step: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-cache --selector=region!=west --timeout=90s` in the runbook.

bea: CSV will include columns: prompt_id, category, source_incident, validator_hint, ci_flag. I'll upload a small sample artifact to the ticket.

ops-bot: Linked INF-4599 -> PM-2910; INF-4600 -> PM-2910; INF-4601 -> PM-2910

lia: Timeline: INF-4600 PR in 3 days, INF-4599 prototype in 4 days, INF-4601 CI + dashboard in 10 days. I'll schedule a follow-up 2-week ops sync to demo.

mira: Great. Also add an "owner demo" line in the ops sync so each owner shows artifacts. If anything slips, leave a blocker comment on the ticket.

omar: I'll post the infra PR and ping reviewers.

bea: uploading CSV now. PR link in INF-4600.

lia: wiring CI and dashboard; will post PRs to INF-4601 when ready.

mira: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop: I'll update PM-2910 with these INF links and set a reminder for the ops sync. :thumbsup:
